A sell-everything sellfile with a thresholded safeguard. improvementChanceThreshold expands the protected set beyond the quota's top-N, which needs per-(artifact, rule) improvement chances to reach detection; passing an empty map silently protects only the quota. The threshold uses the per-level OBJECT form: a bare number is the legacy shape that sfcIO normalises away at import, so the native reader does not accept it and would silently drop the threshold.
